units.source_text: 自不必说，昨日参与船游的侍女之中，凡皇后身边的侍女，

en.t: Needless to say, among the ladies-in-waiting who took part in yesterday's boating excursion, all those in attendance on the Empress

units.source_text: 紫姬都赐与优美的赏品，为免烦冗，概不详述。

en.t: received elegant gifts from Lady Murasaki; to avoid tedious detail, they will not be described here.

units.source_text: 在这六条院中，此种游宴歌舞之事，几乎昼夜不绝。

en.t: At this Rokujo estate, such banquets, excursions, music, and dancing went on almost without pause, day and night.

units.source_text: 人人欢笑度日，诸侍女自然也都无忧无虑，恣意享乐。

en.t: Everyone passed the days in laughter and delight, and the ladies-in-waiting too naturally lived carefree lives, enjoying themselves as they pleased.

units.source_text: 各殿女眷，时时互通音问。

en.t: The women of the various residences often exchanged messages with one another.
